notes.content:

notes.title: The "?" Bathroom game "crash"
notes.content:
Hello there everyone!

Faris here,
So lotsss of the reviews/comments I received are about the game "crashing" when entering the third bathroom (The "?" Bathroom).  The game "crash" is intentional. I thought it would be creepy/scary. Although after seeing the amount of people who told me about it and saw it as a negative thing, I would probably rethink the whole thing. Apologies for the confusion. 

Turning on the brightness and looking at the top of the washroom stall should reveal what crashes the game :)
Don't get too close or wait too long though.
